doc_audits.summary: Direct access to the SambaNova Cloud API documentation endpoint redirects to a login page, and public resource verification was inconclusive regarding an active free tier.
Verification was blocked by a Vercel Security Checkpoint, leaving the status of the developer free tier unconfirmed.
Cerebras actively offers its Free Trial tier with $5 in credits expiring in 30 days upon adding a payment method, supporting gpt-oss-120b and qwen-3.8-27b at 1M tokens per day.
Verification of the Cloudflare Workers AI documentation confirms that the rate-limited developer free tier is currently active.
Antigravity agent interaction v1_ChdxTXZ1YW8tbU02U24xTWtQajdmVy1BYxIXcU12dWFvLW1NNlNuMU1rUGo3ZlctQWM timed out after 60s
NVIDIA NIM's free tier is confirmed active, offering 1,000 trial credits, a 90-day evaluation window, and requiring no credit card upfront.

Observations show that z.ai redirects to chat.z.ai and requires checking pricing and API endpoints on related domains like bigmodel.cn, leaving the $0 developer free tier unverified and unconfirmed as active.
GitHub Copilot Free is actively offered with an allowance of GitHub AI Credits, limited agents, auto model selection, and up to 2,000 code completions per month.
The Kiro pricing page confirms that the $0 developer free tier is currently active.
Trae's $0 developer free tier is confirmed active based on product data extracted from the official pricing page.
Bolt.new actively offers a free tier providing 1,000,000 tokens per month with a 300,000 daily token cap resetting every calendar month without rollover.
Lovable's free tier is confirmed active with access to frontier models like Fable 5.1 governed by credits and rate limits.
v0 actively offers a free plan granting 7 messages per day with bundled frontier models, plus a one-time $5 credit bonus for new accounts.
Kaggle Notebooks actively offers free GPU compute with a weekly resetting quota of 30 hours (or higher) for deep learning workloads.
Hugging Face Spaces continues to offer a rate-limited free tier including up to two ZeroGPU Gradio spaces and Static Spaces without requiring a credit card.
Cursor actively offers a Free tier at $0/month with limited AI usage, including limited agent and chat requests.
Documentation cross-referencing confirms that Windsurf's rate-limited free tier for standard models remains active.
Devin actively offers its Free tier featuring a light agent coding quota, free SWE-2 access, limited model availability, and unlimited inline edits and Tab completions.
Qoder's Free tier is confirmed active with a 2-week Pro trial and basic model quotas.
Verification of the Antigravity pricing page confirms the $0 developer free tier is currently active.
Google Colab actively offers its rate-limited free tier providing dynamic access to GPUs/TPUs for up to 12-hour interactive sessions along with integrated Gemini AI coding features.
Figma's free Starter tier is confirmed active, offering core design tools and 150 daily AI generation credits without requiring a credit card.
Canva's free tier is confirmed active based on the pricing page and FAQ inspection.

I've confirmed the existence of trial credits with the "Framer (Free)" tier. I've noted the 500 one-time AI trial credits for workspaces without a subscription and observed that this translates to approximately 1-3 page generation or design sessions. No credit card is needed. These credits are a one-time thing, not a monthly reset, and agent features stop working if credits run out, unless upgraded.
Replit continues to actively offer the free Starter plan with a daily Agent allowance, basic Agent access, and limited monthly cloud credits.

Cohere actively offers its rate-limited free trial tier providing 20 requests per minute and 1,000 API calls per month across cataloged models including Command A+, Command A Reasoning, Command R+, Command R, and Command R7B.
The SiliconFlow documentation confirms that the trial credit system and developer free tier remain active, offering a $200 credit valid for 90 days without requiring a credit card.
DeepSeek's free tier and initial developer promotional credits remain active as documented on their platform.
The Starter tier provides a free allowance of $10 in monthly credits, no credit card required, and remains active for traces, evals, and team use.

Deepgram actively offers $200 in free trial credits upon sign-up with no credit card required, covering over 700 hours of transcription across its speech-to-text and text-to-speech models including Nova-3, Nova-2, Flux, and Aura.
AssemblyAI's free tier is confirmed active, allowing free signup and immediate transcription access without requiring a credit card.
Dots Studio's free tier featuring trial credits is confirmed active on their platform.
Liquid AI actively offers $2 in free API credits for new developer accounts upon console signup.

candidate_audits.name: Recursive AI
candidate_audits.notes: [The Grant] Recursive AI does not currently provide an active developer inference free tier or trial credits on their website. [The Output] No developer API playground or free tier options were identified during the audit. [The Process] The evaluation of the website at https://recursive.ai did not reveal any self-serve API access or free tier registration pathways. [The Condition] Access to services requires further verification or direct contact as no public $0 developer tier is advertised.
candidate_audits.summary: Recursive AI does not currently offer a verified free tier or trial credits for developer inference.
